title: Phase 9 one-factor-at-a-time energy model sensitivity
role: independent sensitivity cohort; not used to tune Strategy E
range_interpretation: Plus/minus 25 percent are explicit engineering stress scenarios around uncalibrated simulator coefficients, not literature-derived confidence intervals or claims about any device. Each factor is changed independently and applied identically to every strategy's planning and runtime calculations.

formula_audit.relay: relay_power_w * time_step_s / 3600 only for a runtime interval with drone-relayed service; the conservative return budget reserves both hover and relay power
formula_audit.runtime_accounting: movement and operation energy are added once in each simulation tick; planning estimates and protected return budgets constrain feasibility but are not separately added to measured energy
